{"id":2072537128,"question_id":4355,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 days, 23 hours","timestamp":1784391250,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2072537128/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Rearrange String to Avoid Character Pair","memory":"9.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string rearrangeString(string s, char x, char y) {\n        int countx = 0;\n        int county = 0;\n\n        string news = \"\";\n\n        for(int i = 0; i <s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(s[i] == x) countx++;\n            else if(s[i] == y) county++;\n            else news.push_back(s[i]);\n        }\n\n        if(countx == 0) return s;\n        while(county--) news.push_back(y);\n        while(countx--) news.push_back(x);\n\n        return news;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"rearrange-string-to-avoid-character-pair","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2337}
